text: Cream and milk are blended to the fat grade (10.5 to under 18 %); nothing is soured or cultured. The figures are the US legal definition.

steps.note: The blend is brought to between 10.5 % and under 18 % milkfat.
Emulsifiers, stabilisers, sweeteners and flavourings may be added, though none is required.
